target_customer: Small and medium businesses that pay bills and invoice customers
problem: Small businesses lose time on accounts payable and receivable and face cash flow gaps on large bills.
business_model: Free payments tool with fees on buy now pay later financing of bills
product_category: SMB payables, receivables and cash flow fintech

founders.name: Alen Cvisic
founders.background_notes: No bio on the YC page.

founders.name: Guillaume Simard
founders.background_notes: Describes a career building SaaS and fintech; Sequoia invited him to be a Scout in 2022.

technical_complexity.rationale: Payments, bank connectivity and credit underwriting for financing bills are standard fintech engineering with compliance work.

defensibility.rationale: Free AP tooling was easy to copy and incumbents offered similar features; any edge came from the financing product.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Square announced it welcomed the Tola team on August 11, 2025, an acquihire style deal.

market_need_then: SMBs commonly handled AP manually, but no dated 2022 demand source was retrieved.

branding.domain_note: Uses tolahq.com with an HQ suffix, not tola.com; date unknown.

identity.voice_and_tone: Simple, fast and free positioning on the YC page.

brand_strength.rationale: Short name but no press about the brand; coverage focused on the Sequoia seed and the Square deal.

outcome_analysis: Tola was in the Winter 2022 batch, raised a roughly 10 million seed led by Sequoia in October 2024 and was absorbed by Square within ten months, in August 2025. Square framed it as welcoming the team to build cash flow tools, which fits an acquihire after a strong seed rather than a standalone outcome.
notes: CB Insights shows a 0.5M convertible note on 2022-01-01 and 500K total, unverified and conflicting, so not recorded as a round. The seed amount rests on Seedtable and VCBacked; Sequoia's post confirms it led but gives no amount. Company site returned 403. No dated 2022 competitor sources found; current Bill, Ramp and Tipalti comparisons are not as of founding. The acquihire label comes from Square's wording about welcoming the team; terms undisclosed.
